profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Elsevier
profile.summary:
I’m a Software Engineer with a strong foundation in full-stack development, currently working as a Software Engineer III at Elsevier. I enjoy building reliable, user-focused software and tackling problems that sit at the intersection of performance, usability, and maintainability.

I graduated from Lehigh University with a B.S. in Computer Science and Engineering, with minors in Data Science and Political Science. During my time at Lehigh, I was deeply involved in both technical and leadership roles, serving as Vice President of Women in Computer Science and Treasurer for the Lehigh Coders Community. These experiences strengthened my collaboration, leadership, and communication skills while keeping me closely connected to the tech community.

In my current role at Elsevier, I primarily use JavaScript to design and deliver new customer-facing features. In 2025, I led efforts to modernize several applications by containerizing services and building a full CI/CD pipeline, significantly reducing deployment overhead and improving release reliability.

Outside of work, I’m passionate about mentoring and teaching, with experience as a peer tutor and note taker supporting accessible education. I also enjoy problem-solving projects, learning new programming languages, and staying active in my community by volunteering.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
-Merged three code bases into one new repository to cut remaining WCAG 2.1 AA remediation work in half
-Containerized two products and transitioned them from Jenkins EC2 deployments to GitHub Actions ECS Fargate deployments
-Designed and developed AI skills and agents to remediate and prevent the reintroduction of accessibility violations across modern and legacy UI stacks

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
-Led containerization initiatives for multiple applications, enhancing deployment consistency, scalability, and maintainability.
-Designed and implemented end-to-end CI/CD pipelines to streamline the software development lifecycle (SDLC), reducing deployment overhead and accelerating release cycles.
-Developed and maintained customer-facing features, managing the full lifecycle from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and post-release support.
-Applied best practices in DevOps, automation, and software engineering to improve overall system reliability and developer efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Developed and enhanced customer-facing features using JavaScript and React.
-Wrote unit and automated tests using Jest and Selenium to ensure functionality and reliability.
-GitHub Actions to automate workflows and manage end-of-life software dependencies.

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description: Help students build the skills necessary to excel in Linear Methods (Math 205)
